StartTime.NAME: StartTime
StartTime.DESCRIPTION: Scheduled start of the execution window (UTC)

EndTime.NAME: EndTime
EndTime.DESCRIPTION: Scheduled end of the execution window (UTC); must be after StartTime

RiskAversion.NAME: RiskAversion
RiskAversion.DESCRIPTION: Trade-off between market impact and timing risk (0 = pure impact minimisation, 1 = urgent/aggressive)

BenchmarkPrice.NAME: BenchmarkPrice
BenchmarkPrice.DESCRIPTION: Arrival price used as the IS benchmark; leave blank to use the mid-quote at order receipt

AlphaDecay.NAME: AlphaDecay
AlphaDecay.DESCRIPTION: Rate at which the alpha signal decays over the execution horizon (per minute, annualised units)

MaxParticipationRate.NAME: MaxParticipationRate
MaxParticipationRate.DESCRIPTION: Hard cap on the fraction of market volume the algo may consume

VenueScope.NAME: VenueScope
VenueScope.DESCRIPTION: Liquidity pool selection strategy across lit and dark venues

AllowIntraday.NAME: AllowIntraday
AllowIntraday.DESCRIPTION: Permit intraday scheduling adjustments in response to real-time alpha and volume signals

PostTradeAction.NAME: PostTradeAction
PostTradeAction.DESCRIPTION: Action taken when the execution window closes with residual quantity
